mutations.name: the sandbox lets the story navigate the console page
mutations.replace: export const LIVE_SANDBOX = "allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-forms allow-top-navigation";
kills: is sandboxed to scripts, its own origin and forms, with no permissions

mutations.name: a bridge message is trusted from any window
kills: swaps its PNG for the story on its own frame's ready, and ignores the same message from another window

mutations.name: a bridge message is trusted from any origin
kills: swaps its PNG for the story on its own frame's ready, and ignores the same message from another window

mutations.name: a dead story remounts forever
kills: remounts once when no ready comes within 10 s, then shows the PNG with a notice and Retry

mutations.name: every section is live by default, Ship-bound ones too
kills: in a Ship-bound section shows the approved PNG with Open live, and mounts no story until asked

mutations.name: no cap on mounted stories
kills: mounts at most 4 stories on a phone; the rest wait as their PNG

mutations.name: a frame's reason is not shown
kills: with only a reason, shows its PNG and the reason, and mounts no story
